name: TJWA_TC_BUT_SWITCH_001 - User is able to switch between Premium, Latest and Popular tabs vice versa with correct content
fullName: TJWA_TC_BUT_SWITCH_001 - User is able to switch between Premium, Latest and Popular tabs vice versa with correct content
description:
Verify switching between Premium, Latest and Popular tabs loads the correct tractor data for each tab without stale content.

Expected: Each tab should display its respective tractor data and cycling back to Premium should show the original data.
